name: Mythra and Pyra
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:light)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Mythra and Pyra are a Legendary Blade created from a Core Crystal, wielding the Aegis Blade with Light and Fire elements. Mythra offers short-range precognition, Light manipulation, and speed, while Pyra offers destructive firepower; they are alternate forms of one entity, only one out at once. As a Blade they grant their Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, drain user energy to act, and scale with user strength and bond. (No core revival or Pneuma)
